newsitem.title: FRANCE: TNT to launch next day before 9am express service.
newsitem.headline: TNT to launch next day before 9am express service.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide plans to launch a new intra-European express service, Euro 1, later this month, a company statement said on Thursday.
From September 30, TNT will be offering customers a next-day before 9a.m., time-guarantee express service, from 17 European countries.
Express shipments such as documents, samples, spare parts and components will be covered by the new service.

"Euro 1 demonstrates our ability to respond to developments in the market and to provide services and products more adapted to the requirements of European businesses," said James Wilson, GD Express Worldwide, vice-President Europe,
The Euro 1 service will shorten delivery deadlines currently offered by express operators by three to four hours, TNT said. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
